full_judgment: "All previous proposals for settlement of agricultural khas lands at whatever stages they may be, except where the lease deed has already been executed and registered, should be cancelled and the lands covered by such proposals should be leased out in accordance with the provisions of this Government order. In this connection section 81B of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, may be referred to."
